model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the overall performance (%) of various large language models (LLMs) evaluated within the ABS-AOS pattern, as referenced in the paper “Benchmarking Large Language Models for Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization.” The horizontal axis displays ten distinct categories, each represented by a uniquely colored bar and labeled with its corresponding performance percentage value directly above the bar. The vertical axis is labeled “Overall Performance (%)” and spans from 0 to 60, using a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 20. The bars are arranged in descending order of performance, from left to right. The tallest bar, colored dark green, represents a performance of 61.09%. The second tallest, a purple bar, shows 48.28%. Following this, a teal bar indicates 24.64%, a light blue bar shows 48.83%, a brown bar indicates 27.22%, a light purple bar shows 43.79%, an orange bar indicates 46.36%, a gray bar shows 44.09%, a light green bar indicates 40.87%, and the rightmost bar, colored light pink, shows 43.54%. The chart does not include any legends, groupings, or stacking, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation and numerical labeling. According to the caption, these performance values correspond to the stratification of LLMs into three tiers based on OP_{GM} ranges: Tier-1 (55–61), Tier-2 (41–49), and Tier-3 (25–27), though the specific model or category associated with each bar is not indicated.
